column2: Unite the industrial north under London's rule and restore a single Kingdom of England, reunified from the south.
Unite London and the south under Mercia's rule and restore a single Kingdom of England, reunified from the industrial north.
Bring Scotland, Ireland, and Wales together with England under a single Crown once more, reforming the United Kingdom of Great Britain and Ireland.
Unite the rest of the British Isles under Edinburgh's rule, founding a new empire of Caledonia in place of the old union.

Rather than rule the isles as Caledonia, set aside the crown's own name and restore the old union as it was -- a gesture of reconciliation that will settle easier on English, Welsh, and Irish hearts alike, at the cost of Scotland's own moment of glory.
Unite the rest of the British Isles under Dublin's rule, founding a new empire of Hibernia in place of the old union.

Rather than rule the isles as Hibernia, set aside the crown's own name and restore the old union as it was -- a gesture of reconciliation that will settle easier on English, Scottish, and Welsh hearts alike, at the cost of Ireland's own moment of glory.
Unite the rest of the British Isles under Cardiff's rule, founding a new empire of Cambria in place of the old union.
